description.text: Control Science and Engineering is a comprehensive engineering discipline that studies the behavioral patterns, control strategies, and optimization methods of dynamic systems. Its core objective is to design control systems to enable objects (such as machines, processes, and biological systems) to operate stably according to the expected goals, and even achieve autonomous optimization. From the automation of industrial production lines to the attitude control of spacecraft, from the decision-making logic of artificial intelligence to the energy management of smart homes, control science is the core support for achieving "system intelligence".

duration.text: The Control science and engineering at Xidian University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.
